This procedure details the testing procedures and calibration I1, which 
 recommended to be carried out every year as indicated by Y1 in the title 
 block.

The DTT 7031 is a biased three phase differential relay designed to protect 
 high voltage transformer against internal faults.

It is very rabid operation limits the damage due to short-circuit between 
 phases, between turns on the same phase, or between windings and earth/ground 
 if the earth/ground fault currents can attain relatively high values.

The first draft is initiated by Eng. Ahmed EL Sihy, tested by Eng. Khalied 
 Diab & Eng. Ehab Abuo El-wafa at 18 May 2008, and accepted by General Manager 
 Eng. Saad Kheder and approved by Eng. Abd El-moatey El-rakaiby Head Sector of 
 Mahmoudia Power Station.

Introduction
This procedure details the testing procedures and calibration I1, which 
 recommended to be carried out every year as indicated by Y1 in the title 
 block.
The DTT 7031 is a biased three phase differential relay designed to protect 
 high voltage transformer against internal faults.
It is very rabid operation limits the damage due to short-circuit between 
 phases, between turns on the same phase, or between windings and earth/ground 
 if the earth/ground fault currents can attain relatively high values.
The first draft is initiated by Eng. Ahmed EL Sihy, tested by Eng. Khalied 
 Diab & Eng. Ehab Abuo El-wafa at 18 May 2008, and accepted by General Manager 
 Eng. Saad Kheder and approved by Eng. Abd El-moatey El-rakaiby Head Sector of 
 Mahmoudia Power Station.

جهاز الوقاية DTT 7031 هو جهاز وقاية تفاضلية ثلاثي الأطوار من النوع المنحاز، مصمم لوقاية محول الجهد العالي من الأعطال الداخلية.
إن تشغيله السريع جدًا يحد من التلف الناتج عن القصر بين الأطوار، أو بين لفات الطور نفسه، أو بين الملفات والأرض، إذا أمكن لتيارات العطل الأرضي أن تصل إلى قيم عالية نسبيًا.

أعد المسودة الأولى م. Ahmed EL Sihy، واختبرها م. Khalied Diab وم. Ehab Abuo El-wafa في 18 May 2008، وقبلها المدير العام م. Saad Kheder، واعتمدها م. Abd El-moatey El-rakaiby رئيس قطاع محطة Mahmoudia Power Station.
